headline: Supertech EV files SDD compliance certificate for the second quarter of financial year 2026
hook: Routine compliance filing for Supertech EV
summary: Supertech EV Limited has submitted its structured digital database compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing required by listed entities under securities market regulations. The submission ensures corporate governance compliance regarding insider trading database maintenance. For Indian retail investors, this procedural filing has no material impact on the company's financial performance.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on share price or company fundamentals.
